description: A Windows instance startup script installs a runtime with msiexec /norestart and throws on any exit code other than 0. The reviewer posted it as a non-blocking hardening note, not verified, because a fresh install usually returns 0. msiexec documents 3010 (success, reboot required) as a success, and the script runs once at provisioning with no retry: a verified defect on a one-shot path holds the merge.

findings.title: msiexec 3010 (success, reboot required) would be logged as a failure
findings.body: With /norestart, msiexec returns 3010 when the install succeeded but wants a reboot. The new check throws on any non-zero code, so a 3010 would stop the startup script before the main install step. A fresh install usually returns 0, so this may never happen.
findings.suggestion: if ($install.ExitCode -notin 0, 3010) { throw "install failed with exit code $($install.ExitCode)" }
